sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐秘。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: In 1999, a nature documentary about wolves, called Wolves, came out in IMAX theaters.
sentences.zh: 1999年，一部关于狼的自然纪录片《狼》在IMAX影院上映。

sentences.en: This alpha female is searching for a densite.
sentences.zh: 这只头狼正在寻找巢穴。

sentences.en: It isn't merely a personal choice, but her decision will determine the disposition of the paSt.
sentences.zh: 这绝不仅仅是一个人的选择，但她的决定将决定过去的走向。

sentences.en: The film documents the reintroduction of wolves across the western United States.
sentences.zh: 这部电影记录了美国西部狼群的重新引入。

sentences.en: That's producer Emmett Fitzgerald.
sentences.zh: 那是制片人埃米特·菲茨杰拉德。

sentences.en: And it has everything you want in a nature documentary.
sentences.zh: 它具备你对自然纪录片的所有期望。

sentences.en: Sweeping landscapes, a narrator with a rugged yet soothing voice.
sentences.zh: 壮丽的风景，还有一位声音低沉而又舒缓的旁白。

sentences.en: A potential prey.
sentences.zh: 潜在的猎物。

sentences.en: And best of all, wolf puppies.
sentences.zh: 最棒的是，小狼崽。

sentences.en: The film was designed to combat the misinformation campaigns of the ranching and hunting lobbies,
sentences.zh: 这部电影旨在反击牧场和狩猎游说团体的虚假信息运动，

sentences.en: which portray wolves typically as vicious killers, fit only for elimination.
sentences.zh: 他们通常把狼描绘成恶毒的杀手，只适合被消灭。

sentences.en: That's Chris Palmer, one of the film's producers.
sentences.zh: 那是克里斯·帕尔默，该片的制片人之一。

sentences.en: He and his team wanted to rehabilitate the wolf's image by showcasing the relationships within a pack.
sentences.zh: 他和他的团队希望通过展示狼群内部的关系来恢复狼的形象。

sentences.en: Rather than just a bunch of scenes of wolves ripping caribou to shreds,
sentences.zh: 而不是只展示狼把北美驯鹿撕成碎片的镜头，

sentences.en: they wanted to show the animals working together to raise a litter of pups.
sentences.zh: 他们想展示这些动物齐心协力抚养一窝幼崽的过程。

sentences.en: Our goal was to show close-ups of a wolf pack interacting in complex, subtle ways.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标是展示狼群以复杂、微妙的方式互动的特写镜头。

sentences.en: But filming the intimate lives of wild wolves is virtually impossible because they do not tolerate the presence of people.
sentences.zh: 但是拍摄野生狼的私密生活几乎是不可能的，因为它们不容忍人类的存在。

sentences.en: Still, they filmed inside a wolf's den.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他们还是在狼窝里面进行了拍摄。

sentences.en: And in the finished movie, viewers are let into this private moment as wolf pups cozy up against their mother's belly.
sentences.zh: 在最终的电影中，观众得以窥见这私密的时刻，小狼崽紧紧依偎在母亲的腹部。

sentences.en: Because newborn pups have no way to regulate their own temperature, their mother's body heat is the only thing that keeps them warm.
sentences.zh: 由于刚出生的小狼崽无法调节自己的体温，母亲的体温是唯一能让他们保持温暖的东西。

sentences.en: When the film came out, Palmer went to some screenings where audience members could ask questions.
sentences.zh: 电影上映后，帕尔默参加了一些观众可以提问的放映活动。

sentences.en: And after one screening, someone in the audience asked me,
sentences.zh: 在一次放映结束后，观众席上有人问我，

sentences.en: how did you film the amazing shot of the mother wolf in its den?
sentences.zh: 你们是怎么拍到母狼在巢穴里的精彩镜头的？

sentences.en: Palmer's heart sank.
sentences.zh: 帕尔默的心沉了下去。

sentences.en: Because the truth about that intimate scene in the wolf den wasn't pretty.
sentences.zh: 因为狼窝里那个私密场景的真相并不美好。

sentences.en: Cover your ears, innocent listeners.
sentences.zh: 捂住耳朵，单纯的听众们。

sentences.en: We rented captive wolves.
sentences.zh: 我们租了人工饲养的狼。

sentences.en: We rented captive wolves.
sentences.zh: 我们租了人工饲养的狼。

sentences.en: The shots of the puppies in the den were not filmed in the wild.
sentences.zh: 洞穴中幼崽的镜头并非在野外拍摄。

sentences.en: Instead, the film crew had gone to a game farm where the wolves were more used to humans
sentences.zh: 相反，摄制组去了一个对人类更习惯的野生动物园，

sentences.en: and built an artificial den with cameras inside.
sentences.zh: 并在里面建了一个配有摄像机的人工巢穴。

sentences.en: I was suddenly staring starkly at an ethical dilemma for myself.
sentences.zh: 我突然面临着一个严峻的道德困境。

sentences.en: Did I tell the truth and answer truthfully, therefore betraying our trade secrets in filmmaking?
sentences.zh: 我是说实话并如实回答，从而泄露我们的电影制作行业机密吗？

sentences.en: Or did I continue to lie and pretend that the captive wolves were, in fact, were wired when they weren't?
sentences.zh: 还是继续撒谎，假装这些被圈养的狼实际上是野生的？

sentences.en: Palmer decided to come clean.
sentences.zh: 帕尔默决定坦白。

sentences.en: And when I did this, I could feel the audience's disappointment.
sentences.zh: 当我这样做的时候，我能感受到观众的失望。

sentences.en: And this moment was a bit of a turning point for him.
sentences.zh: 这一刻对他来说是一个转折点。

sentences.en: Up to that point, I think I kind of assumed, well, why would they care?
sentences.zh: 在那之前，我想我大概觉得，好吧，他们为什么要在乎？

sentences.en: But they do care.
sentences.zh: 但他们确实在乎。

sentences.en: People do care.
sentences.zh: 人们确实在乎。

sentences.en: When people watch documentaries, especially science-based documentaries,
sentences.zh: 当人们观看纪录片，尤其是基于科学的纪录片时，

sentences.en: they are assuming they are seeing the truth.
sentences.zh: 他们假设自己看到的是真相。

sentences.en: They are seeing things that are authentic and genuine and truthful.
sentences.zh: 他们看到的是真实、地道、真实的事物。

sentences.en: And when they find out that is not the case, they get very upset.
sentences.zh: 当他们发现事实并非如此时，他们会非常沮丧。

sentences.en: Of course, there's some level of illusion in all filmmaking.
sentences.zh: 当然，所有电影制作中都有某种程度的幻觉。

sentences.en: You're editing footage to form a narrative.
sentences.zh: 你正在剪辑素材来形成一个叙事。

sentences.en: Psst, we do this in radio, too.
sentences.zh: 嘘，我们在广播中也这样做。

sentences.en: But illusions in nature documentaries exist on a spectrum.
sentences.zh: 但自然纪录片中的幻觉存在于一个光谱上。

sentences.en: In some cases, these illusions help tell the truth about animals.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，这些幻觉有助于讲述关于动物的真相。

sentences.en: But in others, not so much.
sentences.zh: 但在其他情况下，则未必如此。

sentences.en: On the far end of that truth spectrum, you know, over toward the straight-up false end,
sentences.zh: 在这个真相光谱的极端，也就是完全错误的那一端，

sentences.en: is a film called White Wilderness.
sentences.zh: 是一部名为《白色荒野》的电影。

sentences.en: I still remember watching White Wilderness as a child when I was about 11 years old.
sentences.zh: 我仍然记得大约11岁时作为孩子观看《白色荒野》的情景。

sentences.en: It was a documentary produced by Disney in 1958 about the high Arctic.
sentences.zh: 那是迪士尼于1958年制作的一部关于北极高地的纪录片。

sentences.en: In this land of many mysteries, it's a strange fact that the largest legends
sentences.zh: 在这片充满神秘的土地上，一个奇怪的事实是，最大的传说

sentences.en: seem to collect around the smallest creatures.
sentences.zh: 似乎总是围绕着最小的生物。

sentences.en: One of these is a mousy little rodent called the lemming.
sentences.zh: 其中之一是一种叫旅鼠的鼠类小啮齿动物。

sentences.en: In one scene, a herd of tiny lemmings approaches a rocky cliff along the ocean.
sentences.zh: 在一个场景中，一群小旅鼠走近沿海的一处岩石悬崖。

sentences.en: They reach the final precipice.
sentences.zh: 他们到达了最后的绝壁。

sentences.en: This is the last chance to turn back.
sentences.zh: 这是回头的最后机会。

sentences.en: The little furballs peer over the edge, and then...
sentences.zh: 小毛球们探头看着边缘，然后……

sentences.en: Yet over they go, casting themselves bodily out into space.
sentences.zh: 然而它们还是跳了下去，将自己活生生地抛向空中。

sentences.en: They hurl themselves off the cliff and into the water below.
sentences.zh: 它们把自己从悬崖上抛入下面的水中。

sentences.en: The narrator tells us that most have survived the plunge,
sentences.zh: 旁白告诉我们，大多数都在跳水后幸存下来，

sentences.en: but then they begin to swim towards the horizon.
sentences.zh: 但随后它们开始向地平线游去。

sentences.en: The gradually strength wanes.
sentences.zh: 力量逐渐消退。

sentences.en: Determination ebbs away.
sentences.zh: 决心逐渐消逝。

sentences.en: And soon the Arctic Sea is dotted with tiny, bobbing bodies.
sentences.zh: 不久，北极海上点缀着一个个上下浮动的小身体。

sentences.en: It's dramatic stuff.
sentences.zh: 这是戏剧性的场景。

sentences.en: Except this entire sequence was staged.
sentences.zh: 除了整个序列是摆拍的。

sentences.en: The producers went to the Arctic, bagged up a bunch of lemmings,
sentences.zh: 制片人去了北极，抓了一群旅鼠，

sentences.en: and flew them to this cliff along a river in Alberta.
sentences.zh: 把它们空运到阿尔伯塔省一条河边的这个悬崖。

sentences.en: And they put them on a turntable that you don't see in the film,
sentences.zh: 他们把它们放在电影中看不到的转盘上，

sentences.en: and they threw them off the cliffside into the water and filmed it.
sentences.zh: 然后把它们从悬崖边扔进水里并拍摄下来。

sentences.en: And lemmings don't actually hurl themselves off cliffs.
sentences.zh: 旅鼠实际上并不会把自己从悬崖上扔下去。

sentences.en: Some lemming species do experience dramatic fluctuations in population size,
sentences.zh: 一些旅鼠物种确实经历了剧烈的人口规模波动，

sentences.en: leading to some creative 19th century hypotheses about what might be going on.
sentences.zh: 导致了19世纪关于可能发生的事情的一些创造性假设。

sentences.en: But the idea of a mass lemming suicide ritual is entirely apocryphal.
sentences.zh: 但集体旅鼠自杀仪式的想法完全是杜撰的。

sentences.en: White Wilderness didn't invent the lemming suicide myth,
sentences.zh: 《白色荒野》并没有发明旅鼠自杀神话，

sentences.en: but it certainly helped to spread it.
sentences.zh: 但它确实帮助传播了这一神话。

sentences.en: The film was seen by millions of people.
sentences.zh: 这部电影被数百万人观看。

sentences.en: It even won the Oscar for Best Documentary.
sentences.zh: 它甚至赢得了奥斯卡最佳纪录片奖。

sentences.en: Everybody has learned that from that film and been misled by it.
sentences.zh: 每个人都从那部电影中了解到了这一点，并被它误导了。

sentences.en: So what we put in these films is importance.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在这些电影中投入的内容很重要。

sentences.en: And that means it's so important that they are made,
sentences.zh: 这意味着它们的制作非常重要，

sentences.en: not only entertainingly, but made accurately and ethically,
sentences.zh: 不仅要具有娱乐性，还要准确、合乎道德，

sentences.en: because they do have an impact.
sentences.zh: 因为它们确实产生了影响。

sentences.en: The lemming scene is an especially egregious example of dishonest filmmaking.
sentences.zh: 旅鼠场景是不诚实电影制作的一个特别令人震惊的例子。

sentences.en: But smaller acts of deception happen all the time.
sentences.zh: 但更小的欺骗行为一直在发生。

sentences.en: And after his experience with the wolf documentary,
sentences.zh: 在经历狼纪录片之后，

sentences.en: Chris Palmer started looking into this stuff.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·帕尔默开始调查这些事情。

sentences.en: He found filmmakers luring sharks closer to the camera
sentences.zh: 他发现电影制作人通过将一桶桶鱼内脏倒入海中

sentences.en: by dumping buckets of fish guts into the ocean,
sentences.zh: 来吸引鲨鱼靠近摄像机，

sentences.en: and a producer using CGI to edit a sea otter into a shot.
sentences.zh: 以及制片人使用CGI将海獭编辑到镜头中。

sentences.en: Palmer is particularly bothered by filmmakers that harass animals
sentences.zh: 帕尔默对骚扰动物以试图让他们做一些令人兴奋的事情的电影制作人感到特别不安。

sentences.en: to try to get them to do something exciting.
sentences.zh: 他认为这一切的发生都是因为对收视率的追逐。

sentences.en: He thinks all this happens because of a race for ratings.
sentences.zh: 当你如此、如此专注于这样的收视率时，

sentences.en: And when you focus so, so much on ratings like that,
sentences.zh: 你不可避免地会转向高度轰动

sentences.en: you inevitably move towards programs that are highly sensational
sentences.zh: 和过度戏剧化的节目。

sentences.en: and overly dramatic.
sentences.zh: 帕尔默的许多批评都与电影制作的视觉方面有关。

sentences.en: A lot of Palmer's criticisms have to do with the visual side of filmmaking.
sentences.zh: 但关于自然纪录片准确性的任何讨论

sentences.en: But any conversation about the accuracy of nature documentaries
sentences.zh: 不可避免地都会落脚于声音这个话题。

sentences.en: inevitably ends up on the topic of sound.
sentences.zh: 这是因为在大多数野生动物电影中，

sentences.en: That's because in most wildlife films,
sentences.zh: 你听到的声音并不是在摄像机滚动时录制的。

sentences.en: the sounds you hear were not recorded while the cameras were rolling.
sentences.zh: 如果你考虑这两种技术的差异，这是合情合理的。

sentences.en: Which makes sense if you think about how different the two technologies are.
sentences.zh: 大多数电影制作人使用非常长的长焦镜头

sentences.en: Most filmmakers use really long telephoto lenses
sentences.zh: 在安全距离外拍摄动物。

sentences.en: to film animals from a safe distance.
sentences.zh: 但没有与变焦镜头相对应的声音设备。

sentences.en: But there's no sonic equivalent of a zoom lens.
sentences.zh: 为了获得好的音频，你需要将麦克风非常靠近声音源，

sentences.en: For good audio, you need to get a microphone really close to the source of the sound,
sentences.zh: 在摄像机滚动时试图实现这一点可能既困难又危险。

sentences.en: which can be difficult or dangerous to try and pull off while the cameras are rolling.
sentences.zh: 你不能只是走到狮子跟前，在它的鬃毛上夹一个领夹式麦克风。

sentences.en: You can't just walk up to a lion and clip a lapel mic on its mane.
sentences.zh: 因此，许多微妙的动作声音，

sentences.en: And so many of the subtle movement sounds,
sentences.zh: 黑猩猩在树叶中沙沙作响或河马在泥浆中发出咕叽声，

sentences.en: a chimpanzee rustling through leaves or a hippo squelching in the muck,
sentences.zh: 根本不是由动物发出的。

sentences.en: they don't come from animals at all.
sentences.zh: 它们是由音效拟音师制作的。

sentences.en: They're made by Foley artists.
sentences.zh: 因此，拟音师的工作基本上是为电影演绎所有这些动作声音。

sentences.en: So a Foley artist's job is to basically perform all that movement sound for a film, essentially.
sentences.zh: 这是理查德·辛顿。

sentences.en: This is Richard Hinton.
sentences.zh: 是的，我坐在没有窗户的房间里，看着电视，

sentences.en: Yeah, I sit in this windowless room, watching a television,
sentences.zh: 为动物发出奇怪的声音。

sentences.en: making weird sounds for animals.
sentences.zh: 辛顿在带有地板活板门的录音室里表演。

sentences.en: Hinton performs in a studio with trap doors in the floor.
sentences.zh: 在地板下面你有六个坑，每个坑都装有不同的材料。

sentences.en: And underneath the floor you have six pits, each filled with a different material.
sentences.zh: 他说拟音师花大量时间在这些坑里玩耍，

sentences.en: He says Foley artists spend so much time playing around in these pits
sentences.zh: 以至于他们互相称对方为坑里猴子。

sentences.en: that they call each other pit monkeys.
sentences.zh: 一个是砾石，一个装满了沙子，一个是满是泥土，

sentences.en: There's one gravel, one's filled with sand, one's full of dirt,
sentences.zh: 一个是泥土和草的混合物。

sentences.en: one's kind of dirt and grass.
sentences.zh: 然后一个是坚固的石板。

sentences.en: And then one's a solid stone slab.
sentences.zh: 每个坑都装有麦克风以获得高质量的声音。

sentences.en: Each pit is miked up for high quality sound.
sentences.zh: 辛顿在高清屏幕上观看该场景的无声版本，

sentences.en: Hinton watches a silent version of the scene on an HD screen,
sentences.zh: 并试图配合动物的动作。

sentences.en: and he tries to match the movement of the animals.
sentences.zh: 通常我盘腿坐在地板上，

sentences.en: Usually I'm sat on the floor, cross-legged,
sentences.zh: 然后我有点俯身在坑上，

sentences.en: and I'm kind of leant over the pit,
sentences.zh: 这样我可以控制我的体重以及我投入到动作中的重量。

sentences.en: so I can control my weight and the amount of weight that I'm putting into the movement.
sentences.zh: 他从脚开始。

sentences.en: He starts with the feet.
sentences.zh: 随着动物的移动，他试图用手去配合它们的脚步。

sentences.en: As the animals move, he tries to match their footfalls with his hands.
sentences.zh: 当你为动物做拟音时，你通常用手而不是脚，

sentences.en: When you're foleying animals, you usually use your hands rather than your feet
sentences.zh: 因为你有更多的控制权。

sentences.en: because you have more control.
sentences.zh: 如果是蹄子，我会用指尖，然后真正把它们推入表面，

sentences.en: If it's hooves, I'll use the tips of my fingers and I'll really drive them into the surface
sentences.zh: 这样你就能得到那种强烈的撞击感。

sentences.en: so you get that hard attack.
sentences.zh: 如果是像狮子这样的动物，那么我会用手指的平坦部位，

sentences.en: If it's something like a lion, then I'll use the flat of my fingers
sentences.zh: 你会得到一种更有肉垫感、你知道的、偷偷摸摸的、潜伏感的重量。

sentences.en: and you get a more paddy, you know, kind of stealthy, kind of stalking kind of weight to it.
sentences.zh: 辛顿做拟音已经很多年了，并参与了许多大型自然纪录片的制作，

sentences.en: Hinton has been doing foley for years and has worked on many big nature documentaries,
sentences.zh: 包括《地球脉动2》。

sentences.en: including Planet Earth 2.
sentences.zh: 有了所有的练习，他说他通常只用一条就能做对。

sentences.en: With all that practice, he says he can often get it right in just a single take.
sentences.zh: 我做的时间已经够长了，知道，你知道的，

sentences.en: I've been doing it long enough now to know, you know,
sentences.zh: 猎豹从潜行转为冲刺的那一刻，

sentences.en: that point at which a cheetah's about to go from a stalk to a sprint
sentences.zh: 因为它的肩膀运动以及它把耳朵向后别的方式。

sentences.en: because of its shoulder movement and just the way it pins its ears back.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你做这事越多，

sentences.en: And, you know, the more of this stuff that you do,
sentences.zh: 你就会做得越好。

sentences.en: you start picking up on these little visual clues
sentences.zh: 你开始注意到这些细小的视觉线索

sentences.en: that all wildlife gives you in terms of what it's about to do with its behaviour.
sentences.zh: 所有野生动物都会通过它们的行为向你暗示接下来要做什么。

sentences.en: So many wildlife films focus on the exact same cast of marquee species,
sentences.zh: 许多自然纪录片都聚焦于完全相同的明星物种群，

sentences.en: like elephants, leopards, crocodiles,
sentences.zh: 比如大象、豹子、鳄鱼，

sentences.en: that Hinton rarely comes across footage of an animal he's never foleyed before.
sentences.zh: 以至于辛顿很少遇到他以前从未做过拟音的动物素材。

sentences.en: When you first come across something you haven't done,
